Name: CR Number
Description: Case Registration Number (facility MRN, replaces OpenMRS ID as the primary patient identifier). Format target: FacilityPrefix/8-digit sequential; date segment deferred to hisp_india_core custom identifier source; interim = HISPI prefix + 8-digit sequential.
Format description: HISPI + 8-digit sequential number (e.g. HISPI00000001). Prefix admin-editable in Manage Identifier Sources.

Name: ABHA Number
Description: ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account) number. Optional - visible by default on the registration form. Aadhaar is deliberately NOT captured as a separate identifier in this system (2026-07-27 decision) - ABHA is the only national health ID we register.

Name: ABHA Address
Description: ABHA (PHR) address - the Consent Manager account handle. Required by every M2/M3 flow: linking tokens are issued against it, discovery requests and consent artefacts are keyed by it. Optional, one row per patient (the address the patient authenticated with).
Format description: ABHA address, e.g. rameshkumar1984@sbx (sandbox) or @abdm (production). Suffix deliberately not pinned so sandbox-verified addresses stay valid.
